'''Gorga Brak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior of [[Clan Varad]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Biography==
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> Gorga Brak and other members of Clan Varad joined in on an attack on the Mandalorian ship the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' alongside the [[Ash'ad]] and the [[Dar'manda]] at the behest of [[Heta Kol]]. There he encountered the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]], who he engaged in combat. The fight ended with his death.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' {{1st}}
